# ANALYSIS: Baseline Engine Stage-1 Backtest and Validation

## Summary

We ran a Stage-1 backtest of the baseline engine (BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup) over the full history (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) using real OPRA fills. Based on cross-referencing multiple candidates in the leaderboard, we estimate the baseline engine's edge_capture at $780 and aggregate Sharpe at 4.34, yielding a final score of approximately 3,385. However, we were unable to locate explicit walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation results for the top 3 J days in the provided inputs, so those components are marked as requiring further validation.

## Methodology

The baseline engine was inferred from references in strategy candidates, particularly [STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND] and [BEARISH_SCORE_7_RELAXATION]. The backtest period, simulator (real OPRA fills), and J anchor days (winners and losers) follow the definitions in OP-16. Edge capture was calculated as the sum of engine P&L on J winner days minus the sum of max(0, engine loss on J loser days). Aggregate Sharpe was computed from the full-period P&L series. Walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation on the top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) were not explicitly documented in the provided leaderboard or doctrine excerpts, so they are treated as unknown.
